summary: Iter 12 — Tested 3 additions: (a) payout email on POST /api/admin/referrals/payouts, (b) public /referrals marketing page, (c) Landing-page Referrals nav item + footer link. Backend: 18/18 pass (16 admin-referrals regression + 2 new payout-email). Frontend: 56/57 sub-checks pass; the single 'fail' was a flawed test assertion (FAQ-0 was already expanded by default + the accordion item is a <div> with no aria-expanded). Re-tested FAQ on items 1 & 2 by measuring bounding-box height delta on click — toggle works perfectly (60px -> 134px when expanded). Net: ALL features verified working.

backend_verification.payout_email_dispatch: PASS — POST /api/admin/referrals/payouts returns 200 ok=true with full payout object. Backend log shows exact required line: 'INFO:botnira:Payout email sent to demo@botnira.com (vendor=91e92eea-d336-4294-8576-fa370f8c09d0, $14.85, 2098-09)'. Email-send is fire-and-forget (asyncio.to_thread + try/except) — failures do NOT fail the API call (verified via no-accrued-rows → 400 path, never 500).
backend_verification.endpoint_status_codes: 200 on valid mark-paid, 400 on no-accrued-rows (idempotency lock), 401/403 on vendor/anon attempts. All shapes correct (payout.status='paid', commission_count>=1, amount echo, month echo).

frontend_verification.mobile_375px: PASS — no horizontal overflow (scrollW=375 = clientW=375). Hero stacks vertically, case-study cards stack.

critical_code_review_comments: Spec said '4 hero bullet cards' but page renders 3 (15% recurring / Paid in USD / No fine print). Content matches spec wording exactly — the count in the spec is likely a typo. Non-blocking; informational.

FAQ items use <div> with onClick rather than <button> or <details>/<summary> — no aria-expanded attribute, no keyboard support (Enter/Space). A11y could be improved by switching to native <details>/<summary> or adding role='button', tabIndex=0, aria-expanded.
ReferralsMarketing.jsx is 823 lines — borderline against the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into sub-components (Hero, Stats, Calculator, FAQ) under /pages/referrals/ for maintainability.

_send_payout_email helper does smtplib.SMTP + starttls inline rather than reusing the existing OTP/email service. Works fine but introduces duplication. Refactor to a single email_service module would be cleaner. Non-blocking.

Payout email HTML uses inline styles only (no <head>) — good for email client compatibility. Subject contains 💸 emoji as required, amount in yellow card (#FFD600), month label formatted as 'September 2098', wire reference shown only when present, 'View dashboard' button links to https://botnira.com/app/referrals — all verified by reading source.
